summary: The reporter requests an update to the native-package third-party notices so obsolete GIF and zlib licensing text is removed and the notices accurately reflect dependencies compiled into SkiaSharp packages.

repoLinks.description: Merged cleanup that removes the obsolete libmicrohttpd notice.
Dependency audit that identifies microhttpd as unused and lists active dependencies.
Reporter-provided upstream reference for the historical GIF codec removal.
Reporter-provided upstream reference for removal of mozzconf.h.

fixStatus.reason: PR #5403 resolved only the libmicrohttpd portion; the current notice source still contains separate GIF and zlib sections, including the mozzconf.h tri-license statement.

analysis.summary: The packaged THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt is a direct pack-time copy of External-Dependency-Info.txt. The merged libmicrohttpd cleanup addressed one obsolete notice, but the current source still contains GIF and zlib text identified by the reporter. The repository dependency documentation identifies wuffs, rather than a legacy GIF library, as the active GIF codec and confirms that zlib remains active, so the remaining work requires a focused legal-notice audit rather than removing zlib itself.
analysis.rationale: This is a well-scoped request to correct package legal metadata, not a runtime defect or a request for a new rendering API. The packaging target directly establishes area/Build, while current source and dependency documentation confirm that the obsolete GIF notice and stale zlib wording require review after the independently merged libmicrohttpd removal.

keySignals.text: The native NuGet packages ship a THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt file which comes from External-Dependency-Info.txt.
keySignals.interpretation: Identifies the package metadata and source notice file in scope.

keySignals.text: The libSkiaSharp.pdb contains Wuffs, SPIRV-Cross, D3D12MemoryAllocator, and VulkanMemoryAllocator paths that are missing from the notices.
keySignals.interpretation: The audit should consider both stale entries and potentially omitted active dependencies.

keySignals.text: Remove the obsolete libmicrohttpd third-party license notice from External-Dependency-Info.txt.
keySignals.interpretation: One requested cleanup has already merged, but does not cover the remaining entries.

codeInvestigation.finding: The native-assets packaging item includes External-Dependency-Info.txt at PackagePath THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, so editing the notice source changes the generated notice shipped by native packages.
The current source still contains a distinct gif notice section.
The current zlib section still includes the mozzconf.h MPL/GPL/LGPL tri-license statement at line 2196.
The dependency inventory lists wuffs as the active GIF codec and lists zlib as an active compression dependency; zlib notice wording should be corrected without removing zlib's required notice.
The unreleased release notes record PR #5403 as removal of the obsolete libmicrohttpd notice.

workarounds: For immediate dependency due diligence, consult documentation/dev/dependencies.md together with the package-specific notice; it identifies active native dependencies, including wuffs for GIF support and zlib for compression.

The libmicrohttpd portion is already addressed by merged PR #5403 and is documented for the upcoming 4.156.0 release; consumers need the release containing that change for the updated packaged notice.
nextQuestions: Which exact native package variants contain the additional Wuffs, SPIRV-Cross, D3D12MemoryAllocator, and VulkanMemoryAllocator binaries identified from the Windows PDB?
Do all platform-specific native packages receive the same complete notice file, or is package-specific notice generation needed?
What current upstream license text should replace the obsolete mozzconf.h statement while retaining the required zlib attribution?

resolution.hypothesis: External-Dependency-Info.txt has drifted from the current native dependency set because it is packaged unchanged rather than being derived from the native build dependency inventory.

proposals.title: Audit and synchronize third-party notices
proposals.description: Compare the dependencies compiled into each native package with External-Dependency-Info.txt, remove obsolete GIF text, replace the obsolete mozzconf.h wording while retaining the required zlib notice, and add any verified missing active dependency notices.

proposals.title: Use the dependency inventory pending a release
proposals.description: Use documentation/dev/dependencies.md as the current implementation inventory for due diligence while the package notice audit is completed; it is not a substitute for shipping corrected notices.

resolution.recommendedReason: It resolves both categories of reported drift: obsolete license wording and potentially missing notices for compiled dependencies.

actionability.reason: The remaining request is valid and source-backed, but a package-by-package dependency and legal-text audit is needed before changing notices or deciding which additional attributions are required.

actions.description: Apply the feature-request and build-area labels.
Cross-reference the completed libmicrohttpd notice cleanup in #5401.
